_about: An expedite request (src/expedite.py), per USCIS's 'Expedite Requests' page: no form. A one-page request sheet for the Contact Center call or the online account's secure message, then the evidence uploaded to the online account. An appeal or motion: a letter marked EXPEDITE REQUEST to the AAO.
title: Expedite request
requires_message: The client hasn't been processed yet: process the client first.

expedite_sheet.title: Expedite request: the case, the criterion, why, the evidence

handwork.text: Call the USCIS Contact Center (800-375-5283) or send the online account's secure message (reason: expedite), reading the sheet.
Upload each piece of evidence to the client's USCIS online account.
Record the date, the reference number and who you spoke to on the case page. Ask only once.

exhibits.title: Evidence of the urgency (doctor's or hospital letter, death certificate, employer's letter, invitation, proof of the error)

leave_out.intake_questionnaire: The firm's own intake questionnaire: internal.
